product_one_liner.value: Pack helps HR teams map and assess employee skills, identify gaps against business goals, and deliver personalised development plans using AI, coaching and mentoring.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes skill mapping, assessment, strategic gap identification and personalised AI-powered development; its product materials position these capabilities for organisational talent development.

pricing_page.notes: The pricing URL resolves to a coming-soon page, not plans or pricing. The homepage offers a contact email and legal links, with no public pricing link.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Pack's testimonials page names Allianz Trade MMEA and Gruppo Amadori through representatives describing their organisations' work with Pack. | named_customers.0: The testimonial identifies Maria Grazia Nannetti as Talent Manager at Allianz Trade MMEA and describes working with Pack. | named_customers.1: The testimonial identifies Selene Santacaterina as People & Organization Director at Gruppo Amadori and discusses its Pack programme.

employee_band.notes: The current company-profile count is 251 and the funding profile records 248; both fall within 201–500. These counts are newer than the older announcement describing a 30-person team, but their counting methodologies are not fully explained.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile explicitly identifies Barcelona as headquarters; conflicting Italian location records moderate confidence. | hq_country: The company profile explicitly identifies Barcelona, Spain as headquarters. Other records identify Italian office locations, so confidence is moderated.

founded_year.notes: The company's LinkedIn profile explicitly lists 2022 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index contains HR, coaching and leadership interviews, rather than at least two engineer-authored posts explaining how Pack is built.

public_docs.notes: The homepage exposes contact, LinkedIn, terms and privacy links, but no public documentation, help-centre or developer-portal link. The older product homepage likewise showed no such link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current open-positions board lists AE, BDR and Full Stack Developer roles, with no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title. AI-related responsibilities within the full-stack position do not make its title qualifying.

model_provider.notes: The homepage and developer posting refer generically to AI and LLM APIs without naming a provider. Review of the public blog, privacy policy and available security information also yielded no named model or provider; no public product documentation or dedicated subprocessor list was found.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Pack explicitly claims GDPR compliance. Other standards outside the requested five were excluded. | compliance_certs.0: Pack explicitly states that it complies with GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The most recent dated funding record explicitly labels the December 2025 round Series A. | funding_date: The latest funding record is dated December 2, 2025, matching the investor announcement's publication date; the requested month format is 2025-12. | funding_amount_usd: The latest dated funding record gives a December 2, 2025 Series A amount of USD 6,735,830. This is the recorded USD amount, not an independently estimated currency conversion.

raised_18mo.notes: The December 2025 funding round falls within the 18 months preceding November 2026 and is corroborated by a dated investor announcement.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Junior BDR posting provides an application route and a December 31, 2026 deadline, which is after the run date.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog and company-post history revealed marketing, interviews and an October award announcement, not a completed product release within the six-month window. The homepage advertises a forthcoming December 1 launch. This is a qualified negative based on public history, not definitive proof that no unannounced launch occurred.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small public team roster lists only the founding CEO and CPO at C-level or VP seniority, and the founding history identifies both founders in 2022. No qualifying joining or departure announcement was found. The negative is based on the public roster rather than a complete dated employment history.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The live BDR posting explicitly requires HubSpot experience and tracking call performance inside HubSpot, establishing actual sales-system usage rather than merely an integration. | crm_stack_signal.0: The BDR posting explicitly instructs the employee to track call performance inside HubSpot.
